cards.title: Parents: Don't Buy Grand Theft Auto VI for Kids
cards.body: Rockstar Games' latest criminal game is rated 18 and stuffed with explicit sex, drugs, and violence. It's the most explicit game the reviewer has played and absolutely not appropriate for children.

cards.title: How to Cure Grand Theft Auto Craze: Get Kids Knitting
cards.body: Asking children to turn off video games won't work unless you offer them something purposeful and engaging. Knitting and similar activities can give kids a sense of achievement and an outlet to showcase their talents.

cards.title: Third of Young Brits Have Never Had Sex
cards.body: A new survey reveals that one in three people under 25 in the UK have never had intercourse, with under-45s having sex about half as frequently as in 1990. Many young people are sexting and watching porn instead.
